    is a minimal Spring Boot app whose AI operations run through the governance trust loop
    (Identity → Permission → Governance → Confirmation → Audit → Revoke); the generator module
    turns a business request into real, standalone Spring Boot source.

    delegation token, risk levels, governance binding, the confirmation lifecycle, and the frozen
    permission/authorization wire contracts. This is the artifact generated applications depend on,
    so it deliberately has no third-party runtime dependency — JDK crypto only.
